Web Performance

Modern web applications need careful performance engineering across the entire delivery pipeline.

Start by measuring real user experiences before choosing an optimization strategy for your application.

Caching

A layered cache reduces latency while preserving correctness through explicit revalidation policies.

Teams should document cache ownership, invalidation rules, and expected failure behavior.

Observability makes hidden cache misses and stale content easier to diagnose in production.

The final design should remain understandable to engineers who operate the system later.
